limits.crossProject: Name-mapped data transfer requires compatible deform topology. Branch transfer preserves local coordinates and rejects external dependencies. Motion retargeting offers exact/normalized automatic name suggestions, explicit bijective overrides, rest-relative matched ancestor transforms, proportion and root-translation scaling; ambiguous/reversed ancestry rejects. It does not solve IK foot contacts or copy source attachments/events.
limits.mesh: Exact contours capped at 10000 vertices; native compound pieces capped at 500. Single-mesh holes/islands are runtime JSON only. Retopology defaults to reject/explicit clear; interpolate transports weighted source/linked deformation through unambiguous original UV triangles, without extrapolation. New setup positions are supplied unweighted; old weights are derived. At most 16 influences, no silent pruning. No universal lossless retopology guarantee.
limits.boundaryKeys: Runtime mode preserves original piecewise-linear runtime curves with supporting keys and raises output editor FPS to at least 240 to avoid native frame snapping; seconds and duration are unchanged. Curve mode splits mathematical Beziers but may change runtime approximation. Colors are byte quantized.
limits.binaryPrecision: Matching binary exports supplement JSON vertex/weight/deform data and ten numeric bone timeline channels, including small values omitted by JSON. Bone/attachment identity, type, frame count, key times and known rounding quantum must agree; mismatches reject. JSON curves remain unchanged, and source hashes guard the paired exports.
limits.bakeTimePrecision: Sampling times within one microsecond are coalesced to avoid duplicate keys after native import of JSON/binary float-time noise. Time zero is retained. Dense chained clusters spanning more than one microsecond reject instead of silently erasing fast transitions. Original animations remain unchanged; the rule applies to derived baked animation sampling.
limits.simplification: Legacy numeric simplification uses FPS grid/midpoints/keys. Adaptive reduction additionally seeds both animations' key times and recursively samples world/geometry/tint differences. Budget/depth exhaustion cannot pass; failed reduction retries then keeps original keys. No continuous mathematical error bound.
limits.baking: Selective bone baking rejects unsupported non-bone Slider sources. Full-rig baking captures all interacting constraint results including slot color/attachments/sequence/deform/draw order, disables mixes only in the new animation, and validates sampled world states. Conflicting inherited-link deform states reject. Max 1500 frames/200000 bone samples; physics 500000 integration bone steps. World mirror and layers use sampled full-rig baking; between-frame equivalence is not proven.
limits.physics: Ordinary previews reset at zero. Repeated-loop checks retain actual integration history through warmup and measured cycles. They report finite sampled convergence, not mathematical infinite-loop stability.
limits.nativeRoundTrip: Exported data verification cannot prove preservation of editor-only metadata or visual GPU equivalence. Exact original archives retain all native bytes; collected previews have portable paths. Archived native internal resource paths remain original. Edited/reimported metadata preservation remains unproven.
limits.nativeVideo: The native OpenGL video exporter is not invoked. Clean CPU artwork frames (no preview labels/borders), configurable dimensions and default transparent RGBA feed local FFmpeg/FFprobe for APNG/GIF/MP4/paged spritesheets. Actual frame-count verification; max300 frames,2MP/frame,64M output pixels,64MiB/file,128MiB outputs. GIF is palette/binary-alpha limited; H.264 MP4 is lossy and opaque, transparent areas black and even dimensions required. Frame quantization can change fractional interval duration; the requested endpoint is omitted by default; near-grid native timestamp rounding is coalesced.
limits.nativeConcaveClipping: Installed 4.3.23 JSON/binary import can force convex=false to true. Diagnosis/preflight and unsafe-publication rejection remain. Only stable convex/inverse clips permit equivalent flag normalization. The importer issue is not fixed. Explicit visual fallback samples the official clipper to ordinary triangle meshes on a new flat rig, retaining selected skin/animation artwork only; original rig, clipping editability, other skins/animations are not retained in this derived output. Max300 frames/500 compound slots/20000 triangle samples. Native readback and sampled pixel comparison required.
limits.liveUnsavedEditorState: Unavailable: no supported editor-internal structural automation API identified. See official evidence and alternatives in RESEARCH.json. Save manually before background editing.
limits.savedSynchronization: Saved .spine/JSON only; source files never written. Native inputs need CLI. Detects project and all referenced image/audio changes after stability delay, with periodic full hashes. Default1h/20 revisions/512MiB recorded archives; max8 live watches/100 revisions/1GiB input/10000 resource files. Limits/stop checked between stages: a current archive or CLI export can finish, so physical disk usage is not a hard quota. CLI temporary exports are separate. Twenty consecutive errors stop until explicit resume. Immutable commit records and archive verification recover publication status without duplicating a committed revision. Unsaved editor memory remains unavailable.
limits.userProductionRegression: User-reported approval remains bound to the five exact formal clips: 01,02,03,05 and06. Old04 remains excluded; no private production project was supplied.
limits.activeMcpConnection: A fresh standard SDK client launches the current registered spine43 build. Existing application connections/tool catalogs need client-side reload; no supported active-conversation reload capability is exposed to this task.
limits.weightTransfer: Nearest-vertex (default) or barycentric nearest-triangle surface weights in setup-world space; optional maximum matching distance, slot-local mirror, bone maps and target weight locks. Equal-distance overlapping surfaces choose the first triangle. More than 16 influences reject. Five million comparisons per call. Existing deform keys require explicit clearing when weights change. minWeight=0 preserves every positive weight; an explicit positive threshold removes smaller unlocked influences and renormalizes while retaining locked values. Native import may quantize small weights; use an explicit threshold if verification rejects tiny influences.
limits.verificationCoverage: The reproducible 45-suite frozen-core audit records actual current-build MCP requests. Endpoint coverage does not prove every argument, continuous geometry, natural motion or editor-only metadata.
limits.nativeEditorPreview: Open the generated dedicated preview project once in Spine. Image changes use the documented Spine image watcher. Dedicated native preview automatic refresh was confirmed by the user; see work/native-preview-visual-test-2.2.0.json. Does not reload the original editable project or follow native animation/time/selection. Status proves PNG publication only; the GUI has no programmatic display receipt. Last good image stays visible on render failure. Reconnect old MCP clients to access new tools.
limits.editableProjectReload: Not implemented or verified on the installed entrypoint. The isolated bone/slot/keyframe native round trip passes, but it is a saved-file check, not running-editor reload. No supported target-instance, dirty-state guard, no-focus reload and live-state acknowledgement route was established. See work/native-reload-check-2.2.0.json and RESEARCH.json.
limits.nativePreviewRecovery: Renderer process exits are independently supervised, with bounded exponential backoff and five consecutive failures before exhaustion. Explicit resume or a new edit resets the budget; 20 seconds of process stability resets consecutive failures. Supervisor interruption is recovered on MCP startup or edit/update/resume. Saved files only; no native editor memory or display receipt. Same managed native project and PNG are retained across explicit renew/resume. Missing files or changes after the native-project hash baseline reject. Legacy sessions establish the baseline on first resume. System boot alone does not start MCP workers.
limits.nativeContinuousPlayback: High-frequency single-PNG playback failed native visual acceptance (LOADING placeholders). Prefer preloaded native sequence: Spine plays loaded frames without per-frame file writes; native timeline controls remain manual. Resource updates may briefly load images; visual verification is recorded separately.
limits.nativeCurveNormalization: Constant/nearly constant segments only: per-component Bezier ordinate convex-hull bound <=2e-5 of endpoint scale. Endpoints and nonconstant curves retain strict existing checks. Reported normalization is not native GPU visual acceptance.
limits.animationDiagnostics: Explicit character rules and world units required. Default geometry mode keeps all fold candidates. Optional centroid mode classifies posed-centroid clipping and fully opaque later normal layers, retaining full candidate inventory; no full-triangle coverage or self-occlusion proof. Optional physics integrates from reset on the physics FPS grid plus exact requested boundaries; schedule affects integration. Independent previews reset separately. Finite sampling does not establish natural anatomy or visual acceptance. Optional pixels mode evaluates all covered world-aligned cell centers at explicit resolution, preserving unresolved subpixel findings, per-pixel alpha, budgets and marked geometric-region PNGs. Not continuous/GPU coverage or self-occlusion proof.
limits.footContactBaking: Default rejects constrained rigs. Explicit constraintMode=bake samples full interacting bone/slot/attachment/deform motion, disables constraints only in the new animation, then solves direct upper/lower/foot chains. Original rig/animations remain; new captured channels are resampled. Positive uniform scale, normal inheritance and a reference bend required. Doubled-FPS/key/boundary validation includes unrelated world transforms; unreachable/unsupported/over-budget/error cases reject.
limits.temporaryLaunchers: Trusted configured runtime folders are rescanned just before execution. Synchronous missing-executable launch can retry once on a different trusted candidate. Nonzero exits/timeouts never auto-replay. Temporary folders remain dependent on the installed launcher; no activation/settings patch.
limits.visualReviews: Explicit caller-reported review bound to source and all referenced resource hashes; source/resource changes invalidate it. Not an authenticated user identity or native editor display receipt.
limits.nativeCliTransientColorMutation: An observed multi-skeleton CLI load/export changed one RGBA key. Exact round-trip verification rejected it and no bad project was published. Same-code retry passed; cause is not claimed fixed.
